nodes.title: Build frontend app substrate
nodes.summary: The manifest, compiler, lint, build, style and end-to-end test configuration standards/frontend-typescript.yaml presupposes and the empty frontend/app tree did not hold, plus a minimal shell proving the @tui/ui/* alias and TUI theme.css import chain resolve into real compiled CSS.
unmet: playwright.config.ts declares the pages the a11y step renders and a touch-width viewport.
